reviewer: Codex independently compares final unapproved draft; not a human review

checks.quote: 下面的规定只适用于这次试行，不表示其它机构也采用相同规则。
checks.evidence: n0/n10/n11 retain trial-only applicability and no assertion about other institutions.

checks.quote: 书页完整且封面没有霉斑的图书可以进入待分类区；只满足其中一项仍不能入区。
checks.criterion: 完整且无霉斑共同条件，可入而非必须入
checks.evidence: n22/r2 require complete pages AND no mildew; r3 rejects one condition alone; 可以 retained.

checks.quote: 如果同一本书同时存在两种问题，先按暂不入库处理，不必先送去修补。
checks.criterion: 缺页+霉斑时暂不入库优先，非先修补
checks.evidence: r4/r5 preserve both defects -> temporarily no entry first, not repair first.

checks.quote: 修补完成并通过再次检查后，图书才可以回到待分类区。
checks.criterion: 修补且检查通过后可返分类
checks.evidence: n30/r6 require repair completion AND recheck before returning to waiting classification.

checks.quote: 一本书也可以贴多个检索标签，但检索标签不等于主要类别，不要把贴标签画成更换主要类别。
checks.criterion: 检索标签与主要类别区别，无虚构更换
checks.evidence: r8 labels do not equal main category; n44 explicitly prohibits treating labeling as category replacement.

checks.quote: 完成分类之后，管理员记录架位，志愿者再把书放到对应书架。
checks.criterion: 分类→管理员记架位→志愿者上架，职责保持
checks.evidence: r10/r11 preserve classification -> administrator records shelf -> volunteer shelves.

checks.quote: 只有没有超期未还的图书且本次借阅数量不超过三本时，才允许办理借阅。
checks.criterion: 无超期且≤3共同条件→允许借阅
checks.evidence: n61/r13 preserve no overdue books AND no more than three jointly before permission.

checks.quote: 提前归还可以直接登记，不需要等到期日期。
checks.criterion: 可提前登记不必等到期
checks.evidence: n65 contains the full early-return permission and no need to wait, but no semantic edge is drawn for either required relation.

checks.quote: 如果已有其他读者预约该书，则拒绝续借。
checks.evidence: r16 other-reader reservation -> rejection of renewal.

checks.quote: 没有预约只表示可以继续审查申请，不表示续借一定获批。
checks.criterion: 无预约可继续审查不保证批准
checks.evidence: r17/r18 no reservation only allows further review and does not guarantee approval.

checks.quote: 这份记录不能用来认定读者一定故意损坏。
checks.evidence: r20 damage record cannot determine deliberate damage.

checks.quote: 修补和再次检查沿用入库阶段的办法，因此图书可能多次返回待分类区。
checks.criterion: 损坏处理经修补复查回分类，循环可表达
checks.evidence: n85/n86 and r21 preserve administrator optional repair, reused repair/recheck method and possible repeated return; r6 identifies the shared waiting-classification target. Visual return path remains fragmented.

checks.quote: 比较记录有助于发现拥挤位置，但不能仅凭借阅次数判断图书质量。
checks.criterion: 比较发现拥挤，次数不能判质量
checks.evidence: r22 comparison helps find congestion; r23 counts alone cannot determine quality.

checks.quote: 海报设计与续借审查没有直接关系。
checks.criterion: 海报保留独立分支，不强造续借语义关系
checks.evidence: n94/n95 remain in a separate branch; r24 explicitly says no direct relation to renewal review.

issues.finding: Branch 后续评估与无关事项 generalizes source 没有直接关系 into 无关事项, losing the qualifier.
Source endpoint 允许办理借阅 is permission, whereas 办理完成后 requires an actual completed borrowing event; endpoint should distinguish permission from completed processing.
海报 highlights 续借审查 merely because it is the other endpoint in the same quoted sentence. Likewise 标签 binds 主要类别. Selected concepts should not automatically highlight neighboring distinct concepts.
First review returned incomplete JSON; second review returned HTTP 402 Insufficient Balance. No complete review or approved graph exists.

scope: A draft may cover frozen checks and still fail extra-edge, quote, binding or final-review checks. No model-review completion inferred after HTTP 402.
